title: You Can't Sleep Off A Week Of Bad Sleep
description:
Sleeping in on Saturday does not repay the debt you built during the week. Scientists have a name for this, and the numbers are worse than you think.

Made with AI assistance.

#sleep #health #science #brain #habits

scenes.narration: You lost sleep all week. Saturday comes, you sleep eleven hours, and you still feel wrecked. That is not in your head.
Researchers call it sleep debt, and the body treats it like actual debt. It can be partially repaid, but never all at once.
In one study, people restricted to six hours a night for two weeks performed as badly as someone who had been awake for forty eight hours straight. They just did not know it.
Worse, their reaction time stayed impaired for days after they were allowed to sleep normally. The recovery lagged far behind the damage.
And weekend recovery sleep brings its own problem. Sleeping in shifts your body clock later, which makes Sunday night harder and Monday worse.
The only thing that works is consistency. Same bedtime, same wake time, seven days a week. Boring, unglamorous, and the only method that has ever survived a study.
